title: Dihydromyricetin ameliorates lipopolysaccharide‒induced hepatic injury in chickens by activating the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway and regulating mitochondrial dynamics.
authors: Yuan, Liang; Jiang, Xinru; Ren, Yani; Ma, Bingke; Ji, Zhenghua; Wang, Shibo; Hao, Beili; Li, Changwen; Li, Rui; Liu, Fangping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物DHM通过Nrf2/Keap1通路缓解鸡肝损伤，仅含分子对接初步涉及蛋白-小分子结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Dihydromyricetin (DHM) is a flavonoid found in vine tea that exhibits various pharmacological characteristics, including antibacterial, antiapoptotic, and antioxidant effects. Our previous study revealed that DHM can alleviate chicken hepatic injury, but the underlying mechanism has not been elucidated. To further investigate the protective mechanism of DHM, this study firstly predicted by network pharmacology that the potential regulatory pathways of DHM on hepatic injury. Subsequently, the experimental models were replicated in vivo and in vitro using Hy‒Line white broiler chickens and chicken primary hepatocytes treated with DHM and with/ without LPS. Network pharmacology results showed that the effect of DHM on hepatic injury might be related to oxidative stress and mitochondrial function. Further experiments showed that DHM significantly reduced LPS‒elicited serum ALT and AST activities, promoted antioxidant enzyme activities and scavenged ROS in chicken liver or primary hepatocytes. Molecular docking studies showed that DHM could directly bind to Nrf2 and Keap1. Furthermore, DHM treatment regulated the expression of Nrf2 and Keap1, thereby upregulating the downstream expression of antioxidant factors, including HO‒1 and NQO1, in vivo and in vitro. Moreover, DHM modulated the expression of mitochondrial dynamics related factors, including Mfn1/2, Opa1, Drp1, and Fis1, meanwhile, DHM ameliorated mitochondrial structural damage and increased the MMP. Overall, these results suggested that DHM activated the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway and regulated the balance between mitochondrial fusion and fission, ultimately alleviating chicken hepatic injury induced by LPS.
abstract_zh: 二氢杨梅素（DHM）是一种存在于藤茶中的黄酮类化合物，具有多种药理特性，包括抗菌、抗凋亡和抗氧化作用。我们先前的研究表明，DHM能够缓解鸡肝损伤，但其潜在机制尚未阐明。为进一步探究DHM的保护机制，本研究首先通过网络药理学预测了DHM对肝损伤的潜在调控通路。随后，使用海兰白肉鸡和鸡原代肝细胞，在体内和体外复制实验模型，并给予DHM处理，同时联合或不联合LPS处理。网络药理学结果显示，DHM对肝损伤的作用可能与氧化应激和线粒体功能相关。进一步实验表明，DHM显著降低了LPS诱导的血清ALT和AST活性，促进了鸡肝脏或原代肝细胞中抗氧化酶活性，并清除了ROS。分子对接研究表明，DHM可直接与Nrf2和Keap1结合。此外，DHM处理调节了Nrf2和Keap1的表达，从而在体内和体外上调了下游抗氧化因子（包括HO-1和NQO1）的表达。同时，DHM调节了线粒体动力学相关因子（包括Mfn1/2、Opa1、Drp1和Fis1）的表达，并改善了线粒体结构损伤，增加了MMP。总体而言，这些结果表明DHM激活了Nrf2/Keap1通路，并调节了线粒体融合与分裂之间的平衡，最终缓解了LPS诱导的鸡肝损伤。
